emotional_archetype: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST / ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & PROFESSIONAL

design_identity.vibe: Clean, light, ultra-crisp, administrative precision, frictionless discovery
design_identity.tone: Professional, authoritative, high-density, accessible, modern enterprise

typography.font_family_heading: Plus Jakarta Sans, Outfit, Cabinet Grotesk, sans-serif
typography.font_family_mono: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

layout_and_spacing.sidebar: w-64 flex-shrink-0 bg-white border-r border-slate-200 hidden md:block

components_and_structure.header: Clean white header with search input, notifications toggle, admin authentication modal trigger, and tenant switcher.
components_and_structure.stats_bar: 4 high-impact metric widgets displaying: Total Apps, Active Integrations, Categories, and Average User Rating with mini trend sparks.
components_and_structure.filters_bar: Category chip filters, pricing tier filter (Free, Freemium, Paid, Enterprise), sorting dropdown (Popularity, Recently Added, Rating, A-Z), search input, and layout switcher (Grid / List).
components_and_structure.app_card: Minimalist surface card with app SVG/PNG logo, title, category badge, rating star count, verified tag, brief description, key tags, status (Integrated / Available), and Quick View button.
components_and_structure.app_detail_drawer_modal: Comprehensive overlay featuring app hero section, screenshot carousel, feature bullet points, system requirements/compliance (SOC2, GDPR), active installation count, user reviews summary, documentation links, and 'Request Install' or 'Launch App' action.
components_and_structure.admin_catalog_management: Admin-only drawer/modal allowing manual app entry OR 'AI Auto-Fill Generator' (enters App Name/URL -> simulates LLM extraction to auto-populate logo, tags, description, pricing, and features).
components_and_structure.sample_data: Preloaded with 16 top enterprise SaaS apps (Slack, Notion, HubSpot, Figma, GitHub, Stripe, Datadog, Zendesk, Salesforce, Postman, Jira, Loom, Zoom, Vercel, Linear, Framer).

motion_and_interactions.hover_effects: Hover lift -translate-y-1 shadow-md transition-all duration-200 border-slate-300
motion_and_interactions.entrance_animations: Staggered grid fade-in for app cards (delay 0.05s per item)
motion_and_interactions.modal_transitions: Scale up 0.95 -> 1.0 with backdrop blur backdrop-blur-sm
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Bookmark toggle button, install state change pulse, toast notification on copy link / request install

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a pristine light-theme enterprise SaaS marketplace dashboard in React.
Provide complete search, filtering by category/pricing/status, and live sorting.
Implement an App Details drawer/modal with screenshot gallery, feature breakdown, ratings, and install workflow.
Implement Admin Mode toggle & modal with manual app creation AND simulated AI-assisted auto-fill that populates form fields with standard metadata upon entering an app name or site URL.

Preload 16 realistic SaaS applications (Slack, Notion, Figma, GitHub, Stripe, HubSpot, Datadog, Salesforce, Zendesk, Postman, Jira, Loom, Zoom, Vercel, Linear, Framer) complete with SVG logos, tags, ratings, and installation status.
Strictly follow data-testid naming for key interactive components.
Use sonner for instant toast feedback on actions (Install requested, App created, AI auto-fill complete).
